Lovia Terms of Service & EULA

Last Updated: September 29, 2026

1. Agreement to Terms & End User License Agreement (EULA)

By downloading, accessing, or using Lovia ("the App"), you enter into a legally binding agreement and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and End User License Agreement ("EULA"). If you do not agree to these terms, please do not download, install, or use the application. For iOS users, this EULA is concluded between you and Lovia (GenX App Studio), and supplements the Apple Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement.

2. Fictional Entertainment Disclaimer

Lovia is an interactive visual novel and roleplay simulator designed purely for fictional entertainment. All characters, backstories, dialogues, and synthetic voice lines are generated by artificial intelligence. Characters do not represent real persons, medical professionals, financial advisors, or therapists.

3. Zero Tolerance for Objectionable Content

In compliance with Apple App Store Review Guideline 1.2 and Google Play Developer Policies, Lovia strictly enforces a Zero Tolerance Policy against abusive, objectionable, or harmful content. Users must not generate, prompt, or distribute:

  • Content depicting violence, abuse, non-consensual acts, or self-harm.
  • Hate speech, discrimination, harassment, defamation, or threats.
  • Sexually explicit, pornographic, or unlawful material.

Violation of these rules will result in immediate termination of service and permanent blacklisting.

4. User Safety & Moderation Controls

Lovia provides built-in safety controls:

  • Block Character: Block any character at any time to immediately hide and deactivate them.
  • Report Response: Flag any objectionable message directly from the chat screen for immediate review and safety filtering.
  • Real-Time Content Filtering: Automated safety filters block harmful prompts and inappropriate AI outputs before transmission.

5. Virtual Diamonds & VIP Subscriptions

Diamonds are virtual entertainment tokens used for conversational messages and synthetic voice calls. Diamonds possess no monetary value, cannot be redeemed for fiat currency, and are non-transferable. VIP subscriptions grant perks as described at the time of purchase and are managed through your Google Play or Apple App Store account settings.

6. Termination & Inquiries

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access for violations of these terms. For legal inquiries or support, contact legal@genxappstudio.cloud.
privacyPolicyHtml:
Lovia Privacy Policy

Last Updated: September 29, 2026

1. Overview & Commitment

Lovia ("we", "our", or "us") provides an interactive AI companion and anime visual novel experience. We are committed to safeguarding your privacy and ensuring transparency in how information is handled within the app. This Privacy Policy is incorporated into and governed by the Lovia Terms of Service & End User License Agreement (EULA).

2. Information We Process

Local Device Storage: Your chat messages, companionship progress, affection XP levels, custom characters created, and user preferences are saved locally on your device in secure sandbox storage.

Cloud Roleplay Interactions: When you converse or make voice calls with AI companions, input text and audio requests are transmitted to our secure cloud API solely to generate real-time fictional roleplay responses.

No Selling of Personal Data: We do NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal conversations or roleplay interactions to any third parties or data brokers.

3. Artificial Intelligence Safety & Processing

Lovia employs advanced neural language and voice models. Dialogue processed through our API is strictly ephemeral for character roleplay and is not utilized for public model training or shared across user accounts.

4. Subscriptions & In-App Purchases

In-app diamond purchases and VIP subscriptions are processed directly through Google Play (Android) and Apple App Store (iOS). Lovia does not collect or store your payment card numbers, banking information, or billing address.

5. Your Rights & Data Deletion

You maintain full control over your data at all times:

  • Reset & Wipe: You can completely purge all saved chat histories, affection points, custom characters, and local data instantly via the "Delete Account & Reset Data" option in the Profile tab.
  • Block & Report: You can block any character or report any AI response directly within the chat interface.

6. Contact Us

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or data security, please contact our support team at support@genxappstudio.cloud.
